preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n + k + 1 lines: the first line with dimensions and k, n lines for the grid, and k lines for queries.
The dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds [3, 1000].
The number of queries k is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m and all(c in '.*' for c in row) for row in grid_lines)
preconditions.description: Each of the n grid lines contains exactly m characters, each being either '.' or '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(grid_lines[0][j] == '*' for j in range(m)) and all(grid_lines[n-1][j] == '*' for j in range(m)) and all(grid_lines[i][0] == '*' for i in range(n)) and all(grid_lines[i][m-1] == '*' for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All border cells of the grid are impassable ('*').

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m and grid_lines[x-1][y-1] == '.' for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: All query coordinates are within bounds and point to empty cells ('.').

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly k lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(count_pictures(grid_lines, queries[i])) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output is the count of pictures visible from the connected component of empty cells containing the starting position (queries[i]). A picture is counted if it lies on a wall between an empty cell in the component and an adjacent impassable cell.
